content.title: Can I file negative sales or use tax?
content.summary: No, MUNIRevs will not allow you to file a tax form where you are owed money. You will need to fill out a Claim for Refund form and send it to us for review. Once it has been reviewed and approved we can put a credit on your account or submit your request for a refund.
